palette.notes: Code: palette 2 on a still from the black end card; not trusted. Portraits use saturated hue-shifted skin (warm orange to red-brown shadows), bright hair colours and strong blue or purple backgrounds.

lighting: Each portrait has a soft key from the front-top with warm skin shadows and cool rim colours from the background; filmed off a monitor, so moire and glare add a glow.
silhouette: Tight head-and-shoulders busts; big readable eyes and hair shapes give each character a distinct silhouette.

motion.timing: Code: median hold 33.3 ms, 28.49 changes/s, driven by the handheld phone filming the screen; the portraits are stills that cut on the beat, plus one quick whip-blur transition.

texture: Clean mid-resolution pixel portraits with visible pixel grid, light dithering on hair; screen moire from filming the monitor.
camera: Handheld phone pointed at a monitor, flicking through portraits one per beat, then tilting down to a grid of character icons and an Art Fight profile page.

acting.enters: Each character cuts in full-frame, staring at the camera.
acting.acts: Faces react (worried, grinning, smug); the caption says they all blink in the final icons.
acting.exits: Hard cut to the next face; ends on the creator's profile page.
acting.depth: All close-ups; the final grid shows them small, side by side, as a cast.

techniques: one face per beat: rapid portrait carousel
before/after caption hook ('when you learn how to...')
icon grid as the closing cast shot
feel: big-eyed close-up busts + one cut per beat + cast grid finish = punchy character showcase
for_fred: Give Fred and Pixie a reaction close-up: cut to a tight bust of Fred for one beat with a clear expression (worried, smug), then cut back wide; add a 2-frame blink so the still face reads alive.
